carousel.leave_pack_body: You have not finished opening this pack. If you switch sets now, this pack is discarded and will not count towards your session stats.

dialog.cards_per_pack_note: The printed pack counts the cards only. Legend Story Studios counts the token too, which is why their product page says {{total}}.
dialog.estimate_body_sourced: Legend Story Studios publishes the odds for most booster sets, but not a full breakdown of every slot. Where we couldn't find an official number, we worked from other sources/estimations and based us on the ones they do publish. Parts of the these tables are more our estimates, than official figures.
dialog.estimate_body_not_real: Because of that, opening packs here will not behave exactly like opening real packs. Treat it as a simulation for fun, not as an actual guide to what a real booster box will give you.
dialog.estimate_body_not_advice: The prices shown are past market data, not a valuation, and nothing here is financial or investment advice. Verify the prices by yourself and please do not solely use this app to decide what to buy.
dialog.estimate_body_feedback: If you know information about the real published rates for a set and our pull rates and odds look wrong, get in touch with us on our discord. We'd love to get it right.
dialog.price_source: Market prices come from TCGplayer, collected through tcgcsv.com.
